ngaap.notes: Debt refinancing charges (cost of debt purchase, in interest expense) are an Adjusted EPS item but not an Adjusted EBITDA item (EBITDA already excludes interest). Only TTM same-store cash GP/ton published ($5.04), not the quarter. Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation = net earnings + provision for income taxes (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added) + DDA&A (EBITDA excludes discontinued operations). Hence self-check ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub differs by the after-tax discontinued-operations add-back (1.7); not an extraction error.

check_notes: Self-check results: EBITDA check (ni+tax+interest+dda) is off by the discontinued-ops add-back 1.7; passes once ebitda_bridge_disc_ops is included (Vulcan definition, see ngaap.notes). All other checks pass.
